For Saturday afternoon of NCAA week nine, the league heads to Georgia for Atlanta Gridiron Classic. For the game, two SEC powerhouses and rivals going head-to-head to see which team is going to dominate the league for the 2026 season. Plus, there might be one or two celebrity sightings too.

How to Watch Atlanta Gridiron Classic: Florida vs. Georgia Live Online, at a Glance:

- Network: ABC

- Matchup: Florida Gators vs. Georgia Bulldogs

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ESPN Unlimited

When Does Florida Gators vs. Georgia Bulldogs Start ?

For week nine, Atlanta Gridiron Classic takes place on Saturday (Oct. 31) with the No. 17-ranked Florida Gators (5-2) taking on the No. 3-ranked Georgia Bulldogs (6-1) at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia. Kickoff is at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features Florida Gators vs. Georgia Bulldogs?

In 2026, the Atlanta Gridiron Classic broadcasts on ABC. Meanwhile, the NCAA game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances Florida Gators vs. Georgia Bulldogs?

The NCAA Football is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists who have been known to appear at games in the past, include Bulldogs fans André 3000 and Big Boi of Outkast , Samuel L. Jackson, Quavo, Luke Bryan and others.
